requiredMaps.description: RGB metallic, A smoothness; AO is not packed

urp.description: Material Maker images bound by the Unity URP VehiclePBR_VertexWear material.
urp.postProcess: pack MetallicGloss, then run Unity importer validation

blender.description: Material Maker image pass previewed in Blender 4.5.14 without replacing the production mesh.
blender.sourceAuthority: Blender .blend, FBX, hierarchy, sockets and vertex wear
blender.postProcess: load PNGs into a Blender Principled preview; export the original FBX only

three_d.description: Material Maker 3D paint workflow for a disposable UV-frozen texture copy.
three_d.postProcess: export images only; never promote a Material Maker mesh export

procedural.description: Material Maker graph-only generation with no 3D paint import.
procedural.postProcess: pack four maps and validate dimensions/channels

preservation: Do not replace Blender FBX, sockets, LODs, hierarchy or RGBA vertex wear.
Do not import Material Maker generated Unity .mat files as authoritative materials.
Keep generated projects, raw maps and previews under artifacts/ until promoted deliberately.
A successful Material Maker export is local authoring evidence, not in-game runtime evidence.
